title: CGS国际张安琪：科技脱钩加速，中国哪些公司能活下来并抢占份额？
speaker: Angela Chang

segments.en: So, if we do not have the Fed backstop, we have to admit a fact that we have to make that investigation to some of the markets with independent cycles.
segments.zh: 所以，如果没有美联储的支持，我们必须承认一个事实：我们需要对部分具有独立周期的市场进行调研。

segments.en: So we are reviewing, for example, Europe and Japan, but I think China is still overlooked.
segments.zh: 因此，我们正在重新审视欧洲和日本等市场，但我认为中国仍然被忽视。

segments.en: The reason is, let's talk about AI, or of course.
segments.zh: 原因在于，让我们谈谈人工智能，当然。

segments.en: So I think the tech decoupling is accelerating, especially after midterm, after export controls or these factors, right?
segments.zh: 我认为技术脱钩正在加速，尤其是在中期选举后，出口管制等因素之后，对吧？

segments.en: So it's accelerating, make China actually give them strategic opportunity, but there is a very important bifurcation, right?
segments.zh: 所以它在加速，实际上给中国带来了战略机遇，但存在一个非常重要的分叉，对吧？

segments.en: For those companies actually who feel really difficult or feel the bottom next from those restrictions, especially after the BIS new regulation, so we have to screen those out.
segments.zh: 对于那些因限制而感到非常困难或触及底部的公司，尤其是在BIS新规之后，我们必须将它们筛选出去。

segments.en: And for those ones who can survive, for example, the domestic localization, those survivors actually, as we talk to institutional clients, they can tolerant this margin compression.
segments.zh: 而对于那些能够生存下来的公司，例如国内本土化企业，这些幸存者，正如我们与机构客户交谈时所说，它们能够容忍这种利润率压缩。

segments.en: If they can survive, they can take some of the shares and also have their own story.
segments.zh: 如果它们能生存下来，它们可以占据部分市场份额，并拥有自己的故事。

segments.en: So, all of this that we're divulging that we're seeing is this a big buying opportunity?
segments.zh: 那么，我们所透露和看到的这一切，是否是一个巨大的买入机会？
